# Theme: knowledge-management

## Practices

Ways of working you can apply. 6, newest first.

- 2026-04-04 · [Personal AI memory should be plain files you own](../ideas/2026-04-04-explicit-personal-memory-as-files.md) — A wiki of plain files that an LLM builds about you beats hidden provider memory: you can inspect it, own it, use any tools and any model.
- 2026-04-04 · [An LLM wiki has three layers and three operations](../ideas/2026-04-04-llm-wiki-layers-and-operations.md) — Split an LLM wiki into raw sources, wiki pages and a schema file, and run it with ingest, query and lint, plus an index.md and an append-only log.md.
- 2026-04-02 · [Convert books and PDFs with an agent, in chunks](../ideas/2026-04-02-convert-documents-with-an-agent.md) — For good results with long documents, use EPUB over PDF, convert with an agent, and summarise chapter by chapter with book context.
- 2026-04-02 · [Let an LLM compile and maintain your knowledge base](../ideas/2026-04-02-llm-knowledge-bases.md) — Instead of RAG over loose files, let an LLM compile sources into a linked markdown wiki that grows with every source and every question.
- 2025-04-26 · [Go back to RSS, with a feed you control](../ideas/2025-04-26-rss-reader-with-llm-feed.md) — RSS is open and hackable and escapes engagement slop; a good reader would add social features and an LLM-built feed that you customise.
- 2025-03-19 · [Keep one note you append to and review](../ideas/2025-03-19-append-and-review-note.md) — One text note, new items added on top, old items sinking, and a periodic skim that rescues what still matters, covers most note-taking needs.
